<thought>We need a template that breaks a C–Cl bond (6‑17) and forms a C–N bond (6‑7) while converting a halide to a tertiary amine. Using the correct bond format and valid functional‑group names, we can retrieve the appropriate template and then apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["tertiary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-17"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-7"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
